name: Total Records
expression:
VAR Result = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(fact_fire), KEEPFILTERS(fact_fire[in_analysis] = 1))
RETURN Result

name: Total Area Ha
expression:
VAR Result = CALCULATE(SUM(fact_fire[size_ha]), KEEPFILTERS(fact_fire[in_analysis] = 1))
RETURN Result

name: Mean Size Ha
expression:
VAR Area = [Total Area Ha]
VAR Records = [Total Records]
RETURN DIVIDE(Area, Records)

name: Median Size Ha
expression:
VAR Result = CALCULATE(MEDIAN(fact_fire[size_ha]), KEEPFILTERS(fact_fire[in_analysis] = 1))
RETURN Result

name: Large Fire Records
expression:
VAR Result = CALCULATE([Total Records], KEEPFILTERS(fact_fire[is_large_fire] = 1))
RETURN Result

name: Large Fire Share
expression:
VAR Large = [Large Fire Records]
RETURN DIVIDE(Large, [Total Records])

name: Area Share Top 3 Percent
expression:
VAR Eligible = CALCULATETABLE(
    SELECTCOLUMNS(fact_fire, "FireKey", fact_fire[fire_key], "Area", fact_fire[size_ha]),
    KEEPFILTERS(fact_fire[in_analysis] = 1))
VAR N = COUNTROWS(Eligible)
VAR K = ROUNDUP(N * 0.03, 0)
VAR Largest = TOPN(K, Eligible, [Area], DESC, [FireKey], ASC)
RETURN IF(N = 0, BLANK(), DIVIDE(SUMX(Largest, [Area]), SUMX(Eligible, [Area])))

name: Pooled Top 3 Reference
expression:
VAR Result = CALCULATE([Area Share Top 3 Percent], ALLSELECTED(dim_agency))
RETURN Result

name: Agency Top 3 Minimum
expression:
VAR Agencies = FILTER(ALLSELECTED(dim_agency), CALCULATE([Total Records]) > 0)
RETURN MINX(Agencies, CALCULATE([Area Share Top 3 Percent]))

name: Agency Top 3 Maximum
expression:
VAR Agencies = FILTER(ALLSELECTED(dim_agency), CALCULATE([Total Records]) > 0)
RETURN MAXX(Agencies, CALCULATE([Area Share Top 3 Percent]))

name: Exact Size Records
expression:
VAR SizePoint = SELECTEDVALUE(size_points[size_value])
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(SizePoint), BLANK(), CALCULATE([Total Records], KEEPFILTERS(fact_fire[size_ha] = SizePoint)))

name: Exact Size Share
expression:
VAR N = [Exact Size Records]
RETURN DIVIDE(N, [Total Records])

name: Near Size Records
expression:
VAR SizePoint = SELECTEDVALUE(size_points[size_value])
VAR Eligible = CALCULATETABLE(fact_fire, KEEPFILTERS(fact_fire[in_analysis] = 1))
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(SizePoint), BLANK(), COUNTROWS(FILTER(Eligible, ABS(fact_fire[size_ha] - SizePoint) <= 0.00000001)))

name: Source Records
expression:
VAR Result = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(fact_fire), REMOVEFILTERS(fact_fire[in_analysis]),
    KEEPFILTERS(dim_year[year_key] >= 2000), KEEPFILTERS(dim_year[year_key] <= 2025),
    KEEPFILTERS(dim_agency[agency_code] <> "PE"))
RETURN Result

name: Unknown Cause Share
expression:
VAR UnknownRecords = CALCULATE([Total Records], KEEPFILTERS(dim_cause[cause_class] = "Unknown"))
RETURN DIVIDE(UnknownRecords, [Total Records])

name: Missing Report Date Share
expression:
VAR MissingRecords = CALCULATE([Total Records], KEEPFILTERS(fact_fire[missing_report_date] = 1))
RETURN DIVIDE(MissingRecords, [Total Records])

name: Source Unknown Cause Share
expression:
VAR N = CALCULATE([Source Records], KEEPFILTERS(dim_cause[cause_class] = "Unknown"))
RETURN DIVIDE(N, [Source Records])

name: Source Missing Date Share
expression:
VAR N = CALCULATE([Source Records], KEEPFILTERS(fact_fire[missing_report_date] = 1))
RETURN DIVIDE(N, [Source Records])

name: NFD Reconciliation Gap
expression:
VAR Result = BLANK()
RETURN Result

name: NFD Reconciliation Status
expression:
VAR StatusText = "NFD reconciliation: pending; official matched totals not yet available"
RETURN StatusText

name: Annual Area Ha
expression:
VAR Result = CALCULATE([Total Area Ha], REMOVEFILTERS(dim_date), REMOVEFILTERS(dim_month))
RETURN Result

name: Annual Records
expression:
VAR Result = CALCULATE([Total Records], REMOVEFILTERS(dim_date), REMOVEFILTERS(dim_month))
RETURN Result

name: YoY Area Change
expression:
VAR Y = SELECTEDVALUE(dim_year[year_key])
VAR CurrentArea = CALCULATE([Total Area Ha], REMOVEFILTERS(dim_year), REMOVEFILTERS(dim_date), REMOVEFILTERS(dim_month), dim_year[year_key] = Y)
VAR PriorArea = CALCULATE([Total Area Ha], REMOVEFILTERS(dim_year), REMOVEFILTERS(dim_date), REMOVEFILTERS(dim_month), dim_year[year_key] = Y - 1)
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(Y) || Y <= 2000 || Y > 2025 || ISBLANK(CurrentArea) || ISBLANK(PriorArea), BLANK(), DIVIDE(CurrentArea - PriorArea, PriorArea))

name: Five Year Rolling Area Ha
expression:
VAR Y = SELECTEDVALUE(dim_year[year_key])
VAR WindowYears = GENERATESERIES(Y - 4, Y, 1)
VAR AnnualValues = ADDCOLUMNS(WindowYears, "AnnualArea",
    VAR WY = [Value]
    RETURN CALCULATE([Total Area Ha], REMOVEFILTERS(dim_year), REMOVEFILTERS(dim_date), REMOVEFILTERS(dim_month), dim_year[year_key] = WY))
VAR PopulatedYears = COUNTROWS(FILTER(AnnualValues, NOT ISBLANK([AnnualArea])))
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(Y) || Y < 2004 || Y > 2025 || PopulatedYears <> 5, BLANK(), AVERAGEX(AnnualValues, [AnnualArea]))

name: Observed Years
expression:
VAR Years = FILTER(VALUES(dim_year[year_key]), dim_year[year_key] >= 2000 && dim_year[year_key] <= 2025)
RETURN COUNTROWS(FILTER(Years, CALCULATE([Annual Records]) > 0))

name: Mean Annual Area Ha
expression:
VAR Result = DIVIDE([Annual Area Ha], [Observed Years])
RETURN Result

name: Mean Annual Area Without 2023 Ha
expression:
VAR Result = CALCULATE([Mean Annual Area Ha], KEEPFILTERS(dim_year[year_key] <> 2023))
RETURN Result

name: Area Reconciliation Note
expression:
VAR NoteText = "2023 total: pending NFD reconciliation"
RETURN NoteText

name: Cause Record Share

VAR Denominator = CALCULATE([Total Records], REMOVEFILTERS(dim_cause))
RETURN DIVIDE([Total Records], Denominator)

name: Cause Area Share

name: Natural Cause Record Share

VAR D = CALCULATE([Total Records], REMOVEFILTERS(dim_cause))
RETURN DIVIDE(N, D)

name: Natural Cause Area Share
expression:

name: Human Cause Record Share

RETURN Result

name: NT Response Record Share

name: NT Response Area Share

RETURN DIVIDE([NT Area Ha], D)

name: NT Monitored Modified Area Share
expression:
VAR N = CALCULATE([NT Area Ha], REMOVEFILTERS(dim_response), dim_response[response_code] IN {"MON", "MOD"})
VAR D = CALCULATE([NT Area Ha], REMOVEFILTERS(dim_response))
RETURN DIVIDE(N, D)

name: NT Classification Population
expression:
VAR N = CALCULATE([NT Records], REMOVEFILTERS(dim_response), dim_response[response_code] IN {"FUL", "MON", "MOD"})
VAR D = CALCULATE([NT Records], REMOVEFILTERS(dim_response))
RETURN DIVIDE(N, D)
reference: Selected NT populated standard-class record share

name: Valid Month Records
expression:
VAR Result = CALCULATE([Total Records], KEEPFILTERS(dim_month[month_key] >= 1))
RETURN Result

name: Unknown Month Records
expression:
VAR Result = CALCULATE([Total Records], REMOVEFILTERS(dim_month), dim_month[month_key] = -1)
RETURN Result

name: Monthly Record Share
expression:
VAR D = CALCULATE([Valid Month Records], REMOVEFILTERS(dim_month))
RETURN DIVIDE([Valid Month Records], D)

name: Mapped Area Ha
expression:
VAR Result = CALCULATE([Total Area Ha], KEEPFILTERS(dim_grid[grid_cell] <> "Unknown"))
RETURN Result

name: Unmappable Records
expression:
VAR Result = CALCULATE([Total Records], REMOVEFILTERS(dim_grid), dim_grid[grid_cell] = "Unknown")
RETURN Result

name: Mapped Top Five Cell Share
expression:
VAR Cells = FILTER(ALLSELECTED(dim_grid), dim_grid[grid_cell] <> "Unknown")
VAR Areas = ADDCOLUMNS(Cells, "CellArea", CALCULATE([Total Area Ha]))
VAR Largest = TOPN(5, Areas, [CellArea], DESC, dim_grid[grid_cell], ASC)
RETURN DIVIDE(SUMX(Largest, [CellArea]), SUMX(Areas, [CellArea]))

name: Large Fire Share Label
expression:
VAR P = [Large Fire Share]
VAR Magnitude = ABS(P)
VAR SignText = IF(P < 0, "decrease ", "")
RETURN SWITCH(TRUE(),
    ISBLANK(P), "Not available",
    P = 0, "0%",
    P = 1, "100%",
    P = -1, "-100%",
    Magnitude < 0.01, SignText & "under 1%",
    Magnitude > 0.99 && Magnitude < 1, SignText & "over 99%",
    Magnitude > 1 && Magnitude < 1.01, SignText & "over 100%",
    FORMAT(P, "0%"))

name: Scope Agency Count
expression:

name: Scope Subtitle
expression:
VAR Years = FILTER(VALUES(dim_year[year_key]), dim_year[year_key] >= 2000 && dim_year[year_key] <= 2025)
VAR FirstYear = MINX(Years, dim_year[year_key])
VAR LastYear = MAXX(Years, dim_year[year_key])
VAR Agencies = [Scope Agency Count]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(FirstYear), "No matching scope", "Fixed reporting-agency series | " & FORMAT(FirstYear,"0") & "–" & FORMAT(LastYear,"0") & " | " & FORMAT(Agencies,"0") & " reporting agencies | Counts: reported records; area: summed SIZE_HA in ha, not unique land.")
reference: Current dimension context and approved analysis scope

name: NT Scope Subtitle
expression:
VAR Years = FILTER(VALUES(dim_year[year_key]), dim_year[year_key] >= 2000 && dim_year[year_key] <= 2025)
VAR FirstYear = MINX(Years, dim_year[year_key])
VAR LastYear = MAXX(Years, dim_year[year_key])
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(FirstYear), "No matching scope", "Northwest Territories reporting agency | " & FORMAT(FirstYear,"0") & "–" & FORMAT(LastYear,"0") & " | 1 reporting agency | Record and reported-area shares include Unknown; FUL full, MOD modified, MON monitored.")
